Script_Text_Hinglish: Namaste sir, aapka counter kaafi organized hai — kitne saal ho gaye business me?
Sir aapka location strong hai, yahan kaunsa product fastest move karta hai?
Sir ek choti si cheez samajhni thi aapse...
Sir abhi texture aur exterior me kaunsa brand primary chal raha hai aur monthly kitna volume nikal jata hai?
Sir volume toh nikal jata hai par margin me satisfaction hai ya transport nikalne ke baad kuch bachta nahi?
Low margin me volume hone ke baad bhi dukan ki growth slow ho jati hai na sir?
Sir isi exact problem ke liye Swatch design kiya gaya hai — high margin plus fast movement system ke sath.
Sir ₹460 per bag clean margin (40%) plus bag ke andar ₹50 ka instant cash token painter ke liye.
Sir price nahi, profit dekho — agar ₹50 mehenga hai but ₹300 zyada munafa deta hai, toh kya mehenga hai?
Isi liye sir 20-bag trial bol rahe hain — 7 din me na bika toh 1-to-1 swap, risk zero rakho.
Asian replace nahi karna sir — Asian ke sath Swatch ko extra earning channel ke roop me add karo.
Sir ek doubt clear kar do — hesitation product quality par hai ya counter se na nikalne ka darr hai?
Sir 20 bags se trial start karte hain? Test kar lete hain, movement support humari taraf se.
Sir Shubh Aarambh 50-bag lot book karte hain — 5 bag Bundi plant se free aur 1x1ft sample board counter par!
